metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of an omnichannel trading company on Logic4: adopt, sell across webshop, B2B, marketplaces, EDI and stores, supply and fulfil, and close the books.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are documented in customers.json JTBD steps.

streams.name: Implement and Migrate to Logic4
streams.description: From signed contract to live operations: tenant setup, data migration, configuration and go-live with Logic4 consultants.
outcomes: Clean master data from day one

steps.title: Set up administrations, branches and users
keyFacts: Smart takes a few weeks per Logic4's FAQ; larger packages take longer
